newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Great Central says has no Barrick bid.
newsitem.headline: Great Central says has no Barrick bid.

text.p: Gold miner Great Central Mines Ltd said in a statement to the Australian Stock Exchange that it had not received a takeover offer from Canada's Barrick Gold Corp and was not aware of any such offer.

"Great Central Mines Ltd, in response to press speculation, advises that it has not received nor is it aware of a takeover bid from Barrick Gold Corp," Great Central General Manager Company Secretariat David Simcox said in a brief statement.
Earlier on Wednesday, The Australian Financial Review reported that a takeover bid from Barrick valuing Great Central at up to A$700 million was expected within days.
It said Barrick executives had been in Australia recently and had returned to Canada to put the finishing touches to the bid.
Great Central's shares jumped as much as 27 cents or 11 cents to A$2.73 in active morning trade after the reports, but was up 22 cents at A$2.68 by 11.35 a.m. (0135 GMT).
Great Central's surge was the driving factor in the gold index's 15.2 point or 1.2 percent rise to 1,291.
